**Arabidopsis 1001 Genomes · Climate Explorer**

Explore the collection sites of 1,135 *Arabidopsis thaliana* accessions from the 1001 Genomes Project. Click a point to view the accession ID and compare temperature, precipitation, elevation, and UV-B across collection sites.

[Open app in a new tab](https://tahirali-biomics2.shinyapps.io/arabidopsis-1001-climate/)
